subject.title: fix(macos): skip unresolved dashboard auth templates

question: Should this PR become the canonical macOS dashboard auth fallback fix despite the compatibility change for literal `$NAME` and `${NAME}` local auth strings?
rationale: The implementation matches documented SecretRef grammar and fixes a P0 lockout, but it changes shipped local macOS auth interpretation and still needs real app proof before merge.

options.title: Land after proof and cleanup
options.body: Require redacted Finder/Dock LaunchAgent proof, remove the CHANGELOG edit, then land this PR as the canonical fix if maintainers accept the compatibility behavior.

options.title: Accept CI-only urgency
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally land with Swift/CI proof only because the linked user path is P0, while owning the unproven real-app flow and compatibility risk.

options.title: Pause for consolidation
options.body: Hold this PR and choose another overlapping PR or replacement if maintainers prefer a different fallback/error-handling boundary.

recommendation.title: Land after proof and cleanup
recommendation.body: Require redacted Finder/Dock LaunchAgent proof, remove the CHANGELOG edit, then land this PR as the canonical fix if maintainers accept the compatibility behavior.
